storyCards.headline: Bad Blood: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Taylor Swift's "Bad Blood" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Bad Blood" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift from her fifth studio album, 1989 (2014).

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 25 weeks on the chart.

Bad Blood was released in 2014.

Artist: Taylor Swift · Title: Bad Blood · Album: Taylor Swift Feat.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
